body:
The actual frontend now follows the groupmate’s Tonal / Material 3 Sea and Sun reference across the working routes. The wide rail and account strips become a compact app bar, a 96px icon rail and a four-destination phone bar. Registry review is a real list/detail workspace; payouts keep the person, amount and checks together; audit is a compact searchable/filterable table. Household home, concerns, receipts, lists, arrangements, landing, sign-in, overview and batch use the same typography, surfaces and controls.

Stacked on [PR #38](https://github.com/andreirtc/ayudachain/pull/38). The reference’s Kubo Link mark and locally served Open Sans/Source Code Pro are applied consistently. Unsupported PIN/photo/camera workflows were not fabricated. Existing approval reasons, server scopes, protected evidence, once-only payouts, lost-response replay and anchor recovery remain connected. No backend, contract or receipt-protocol changes.

Validation: independent TypeScript and final isolated production build passed; 6 existing navigation/offline-payout Node tests passed; one real registration/review/payout/retry/audit/household workflow passed at desktop and phone sizes. 23 all-route desktop/phone/light/dark captures had no runtime errors or horizontal overflow. The broad legacy suites were not rerun. Physical-device and human design approval remain separate.

The live evaluation preview remains on the author’s machine at http://127.0.0.1:3101 with isolated synthetic data/API8101, a real finalized list/arrangement and concerns/replies. Original database, chain8545, frontend3000 and production build remain preserved. All data is invented and chain checks in this isolated preview correctly show unavailable.

Actual screenshots are committed under docs/screenshots/material-frontend and shown below. [Full rendered-screen notes](https://github.com/andreirtc/ayudachain/blob/c2e171ebfe1f535efdbaa925ab989839c9f62423/docs/MATERIAL_FRONTEND.md) include the additional dark and landing captures.

…en regression tests

The display preferences menu now closes on outside click, Escape, route or account change, and no longer renders an empty row. The logo takes signed-in users to their workspace instead of a public page that hid the account. CSV tools, historical records, payout search reset and the receipt verification link are restored. Adds a single backend test runner, shared Playwright helpers, desktop and phone coverage for session and appearance behaviour, and CI steps for the broader checks.
